name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Vertical section nav with an active pill and grouped links; panel or flat placement.

variants.name: panel
variants.description: Owns a bordered surface for standalone placement.

variants.name: flat
variants.description: No surface of its own; embeds in existing chrome via `data-variant="flat"`.

docs: Vertical navigation: links are `data-slot="link"`; group them under `data-slot="group"` with a `data-slot="heading"` label. Mark the current section with `aria-current="page"` and give the nav an `aria-label`. Variant `panel` (default) draws its own bordered surface; `flat` drops it for embedding in app chrome.
